mechanism_narrative: A sustained month-over-month increase in non-farm payroll employment growth directly signals stronger corporate hiring and revenue visibility, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without requiring additional triggering conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods with positive PAYEMS growth (month-over-month), or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 5.5% in a 3-month moving window, it indicates deteriorating labor market health that triggers immediate equity selling pressure, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances (UNRATE > 5.5% for 3 months), or Rank IC remains negative over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in the federal funds rate above 0.25% and CPI inflation above 3.0% compresses real equity valuations through higher discount rates and margin pressure, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where both FEDFUNDS > 0.25% and CPIAUCSL > 268.0, or interaction term Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS rising above 1.0% and sustained for 6 months), reduced liquidity and higher borrowing costs compress equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods classified as monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 1.0% for 6 months), or regime-conditional Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained month-over-month increase in housing starts signals robust consumer demand and economic activity, supporting corporate revenue growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without triggering conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods with positive HOUST growth (month-over-month), or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production falls below 98.0 (index 2017=100) in a 3-month moving window, it indicates manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate profitability, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances (INDPRO < 98.0 for 3 months), or Rank IC remains negative over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production growth (month-over-month) signals weakening manufacturing output that erodes corporate earnings, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days without triggering conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods with negative INDPRO growth (month-over-month), or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) fall below 600,000 million dollars in a 3-month moving window, it signals reduced consumer spending that lowers corporate revenue expectations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances (RSAFS < 600000 for 3 months), or Rank IC remains negative over any 2-year rolling window.
